print_pose: fully extended 0 deg; this is the pose of model.stl and all parts/*.stl

coordinate_system.x: +X runs from part 1 toward part 3 along the ruler length
coordinate_system.z: +Z is the thickness direction and the build direction
coordinate_system.origin: left end of part 1 at (0,0,0) in the 0 deg pose

joint_features.joint_1: integral pin with bottom and top retaining knuckles

joint_features.joint_2: integral pin with bottom and top retaining knuckles

joints.name: J1

axis.note: axis line is parallel to Z and passes through the 0 deg origin; origin is on the top edge plane of part 1, 0.3 mm outside the 12 mm body width

joints.zero_deg: straight: part 1 and part 2 are collinear; part 2 extends toward +X
joints.one_eighty_deg: folded back: part 2 lies above part 1 (+Y side) with a 0.6 mm body-to-body gap
joints.folding_direction: CCW about +Z; part 2 moves toward +Y during folding
joints.axial_retention: part 1 has two integral retaining knuckles (r = 3.0 mm) at the bottom and top of a continuous pin (r = 1.2 mm). The part 2 stepped bore has a 1.7 mm radius bearing section trapped between them, so part 2 cannot escape along Z.

joints.name: J2

axis.note: origin is given in the 0 deg pose; this axis is rigidly attached to part 2 and moves with it when joint 1 rotates. It lies on the bottom edge plane of part 2, 0.3 mm outside the 12 mm body width

joints.zero_deg: straight: part 2 and part 3 are collinear; part 3 extends toward +X
joints.one_eighty_deg: folded back: part 3 lies below part 2 (-Y side in the local 0 deg frame) with a 0.6 mm body-to-body gap
joints.folding_direction: CW about +Z (negative signed angle); part 3 moves toward -Y during folding
joints.axial_retention: part 2 has two integral retaining knuckles (r = 3.0 mm) at the bottom and top of a continuous pin (r = 1.2 mm). The part 3 stepped bore has a 1.7 mm radius bearing section trapped between them, so part 3 cannot escape along Z.

kinematics.description: Serial 3-link chain. Angles a1 and a2 are non-negative magnitudes in [0,180]. Use the declared fold_sign to obtain the signed rotation about +Z.
transforms: part_3: T3 = Rz(+fold_sign_1 * a1, origin_joint_1) * Rz(+fold_sign_2 * a2, origin_joint_2)
kinematics.matrix_order: p' = T * p; the rightmost rotation is applied first and the joint-2 origin is its 0 deg world position

verification.minimum_static_clearance_note: measured at 0 deg between the rotating ring and the body relief; body-to-body end gaps are 0.5 mm and knuckle-to-counterbore radial clearance is 0.6 mm

collision_grid.result: no interference for any sampled pair of joint angles

axial_retention_test.description: part 2 translated along Z at the 0 deg pose; overlap proves the retaining knuckles block escape
